youtube_title: Traffic Challan SMS? Don't Tap That Link #Shorts
youtube_description:
Scam of the Week #1. Fake 'challan pending' SMS and WhatsApp messages send you to a site that looks like the RTO's, then ask you to install an app. That app is an .APK file that can read your SMS and OTPs, so money can be taken from your UPI, bank or wallet. PIB and police have both warned about it. Fix: check challans only on the official Parivahan e-Challan site or app, never through SMS links, and never install an APK. Money gone? Call 1930 or complain at cybercrime.gov.in.
Source: PIB Fact Check advisory (Jul 2026); Kerala Police (Sep 2026).
